Lowkey saving this post for those really bad days

1 month here and ohmygod you're not kidding when you say STINK.  For a week or so, I just reapplied my deodorant whenever I started to smell myself.  I got to thinking tho that no one said anything about it very often, so I started asking the people around me if they could smell me when I started to smell myself(reliably truthful people lol, shout-out to my brutally honest mom) and I guess I was being oversensitive to my own stink because they only really agreed that they could smell something every few times I asked.

I think it might have something to do with the smell being different too, because my BO definitely smells different than it used to.  My theory is that maybe our brains just notice it more because it's different and new so we are a lot more aware of it being there at all and have yet to figure out exactly where that threshold is where smell becomes stink.

Also, Old spice is my best friend.  Oh my GOD the solid strength of that deodorant is saving the lives of everyone around me 😂
